# DoFlow

> DoFlow is a registry-driven installer (`npx @khoavu882/doflow`) that projects one source of engineering guidance, skills, specialist agents, hooks, and MCP configuration into seven AI coding tools: Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi Coding Agent, GitHub Copilot CLI, Kiro, and Antigravity CLI. It needs Node.js >=24.22.1; a source checkout runs its TypeScript through Node's type stripping, and the npm package ships JavaScript built by `npm run build:package`.

## Home

- [Home](https://khoavu882.github.io/do-flow/): What DoFlow is, what it installs, component and session models, workflow layers, and a documentation map.

## Get started

- [Quickstart](https://khoavu882.github.io/do-flow/quickstart/): The shortest path from a clean machine to a verified installation and a first workflow.
- [Setup](https://khoavu882.github.io/do-flow/setup/): Prerequisites, install modes and scopes, updates, backup, rollback, MCP servers, and per-tool mapping.

## Use DoFlow

- [Guide](https://khoavu882.github.io/do-flow/guide/): Task-based workflows for features, bugs, quality, research, and documentation.
- [How DoFlow works](https://khoavu882.github.io/do-flow/how-doflow-work/): The declared execution procedure, the nine task classes, gates, and readiness contracts.

## Reference

- [Commands and skills](https://khoavu882.github.io/do-flow/reference/): Skills, runtime commands, specialist agents, and git lifecycle intents.
- [Settings](https://khoavu882.github.io/do-flow/settings/): Settings keys, configuration scopes, defaults, and config home directory resolution.

## Contributing

- [Orchestrator context modes](https://khoavu882.github.io/do-flow/specs/orchestrator-context-modes/): The design contract for orchestrator context delivery modes.
- [Operating modes](https://khoavu882.github.io/do-flow/specs/operating-modes/): Operating modes, task states, control boundaries, and transition rules between assisted and autonomous work.
- [Candidate evidence boundary](https://khoavu882.github.io/do-flow/specs/candidate-evidence-boundary/): Contract separating retrieval candidates with ranks or scores from verified evidence bound to tasks.
- [Telemetry contract](https://khoavu882.github.io/do-flow/specs/telemetry-contract/): Contract and schema for machine-local telemetry lines, event kinds, emission boundaries, and storage.
